title: Session Intelligence Engine — Relationship Analysis Engine Specification
purpose: Map every development session's relationships to questions, challenges, recommendations, and certification events. Produces a session intelligence report that answers: What did this session touch? What risks did it carry? How does it relate to other sessions?

session_registry.description: 98 sessions with QID lists, modes, titles, series

question_history.description: Per-question timeline with certification state, difficulty, defects, challenges, recommendations

challenge_to_session.description: Session ID → array of challenge IDs

certification_waves.description: Wave plans with item QID lists and domain distribution

question_to_session_index.description: QID → array of session references with pack, section, currentState

SessionIntelligenceRoot.description: Top-level output for --all mode (single-session wraps one entry)

fields.generatedTimestamp: ISO 8601 — when the report was generated

SessionIntelligenceReport.description: Full intelligence report for one development session

SessionIdentity.description: Core identity and metadata of the development session

fields.title: string — session title/description
fields.questionCount: integer — total QIDs in this session's questionIds array

QuestionInventory.description: All QIDs touched by this session, organized by pack and section

fields.byPack: object — { pack_name: { count, bySection: { section: count }, byState: { state: count } } }
fields.bySection: object — { section_label: { count, packs: [pack_name], byState: { state: count } } }
fields.byCertificationState: object — { Certified: count, Unprocessed: count, Archived: count }
fields.difficultyDistribution: object — { Easy: count, Moderate-Easy: count, Moderate: count, Difficult: count, Very_Difficult: count }
fields.cognitiveLevelDistribution: object — { Remember: count, Understand: count, Apply: count, Analyze: count, Evaluate: count }

PerformanceMap.description: Quality and risk metrics for questions in this session

fields.certifiedPct: number — percentage of questions currently Certified
fields.byHealthTier: object — { HEALTHY: count, FAIR: count, NEEDS_ATTENTION: count, CRITICAL: count, UNKNOWN: count }

defectExposure.totalDefectReferences: integer — sum of all defectHistory entries
defectExposure.bySeverity: object — { Critical: count, High: count, Medium: count, Low: count }
defectExposure.topDefects: array of { defectId, count } sorted by count desc

challengeExposure.byStatus: object — { OPEN: count, INVESTIGATING: count, RESOLVED: count, CLOSED: count, DISMISSED: count }

ChallengeTrace.description: Challenges that originated from or reference this session

fields.directChallenges: array of ChallengeReference — challenges where linkedSessions includes this sessionId
fields.indirectChallenges: array of ChallengeReference — challenges on QIDs in this session (not directly linked)
fields.byStatus: object — { OPEN: count, INVESTIGATING: count, RESOLVED: count, CLOSED: count, DISMISSED: count }
fields.byType: object — { CONTENT_ERROR: count, TECHNICAL_ISSUE: count, ANSWER_DISPUTE: count, EXPLANATION_ISSUE: count, AMBIGUITY: count, OTHER: count }

fields.status: string — OPEN | INVESTIGATING | RESOLVED | CLOSED | DISMISSED

RecommendationTrace.description: Recommendations that reference QIDs from this session

fields.directRecommendations: array of RecommendationReference — recs whose questionIds overlap with session QIDs
fields.bySeverity: object — { CRITICAL: count, HIGH: count, MEDIUM: count, LOW: count }
fields.topSourceScans: array of { sourceScan, count } sorted desc

fields.overlapCount: integer — how many QIDs overlap between this rec and the session
fields.overlapQids: array of overlapping QIDs (max 10, truncated with truncated: true)

CertificationEvents.description: Certification waves that include QIDs from this session

fields.totalQidsInWaves: integer — count of session QIDs that appear in certification waves
fields.certifiedPctInWaves: number — percentage of session QIDs that are now Certified

fields.label: string
fields.overlapCount: integer — session QIDs in this wave
fields.overlapQids: array of QIDs (max 20, truncated with hasMore: true if needed)

RelationshipGraph.description: Other sessions that share QIDs with this one — overlap analysis

fields.totalSharedQids: integer — sum of unique QIDs shared with other sessions
fields.mostRelatedSeries: array of { series, sharedQidCount, sessionCount } sorted desc

OutcomeSummary.description: Overall quality and risk assessment of the session experience

fields.qualityScore: number 0-100 — composite health of questions touched
fields.certifiedExposure: number — percentage of session QIDs that are currently in learner pool
fields.crossSessionReach: integer — number of other sessions that share QIDs

SummaryReport.description: Aggregate statistics across all sessions (--summary mode)

fields.sessionsByMode: object — { READ-ONLY: count, IMPLEMENTATION: count, UNKNOWN: count }

sessionsByCertifiedExposure.highCertified: integer — sessions where >75% QIDs are Certified

fields.mostTestedQids: array of { qid, sessionCount, currentState, section } sorted by sessionCount desc, top 20
fields.topOverlappingSessions: array of { sessionId, overlapCount, title } — sessions that share QIDs with the most other sessions, top 10
fields.seriesCrossReference: object — { series: [relatedSeries] } — which series overlap with which other series
fields.certifiedItemSessionCoverage: number — percentage of 2,221 Certified items touched by at least one session
fields.defectLibraryCoverageInSessions: object — { dl_id: sessionCount } — how many sessions touched each defect class

DIRECT_CHALLENGE.description: The challenge's linkedSessions array includes this sessionId

INDIRECT_CHALLENGE.description: A challenge exists on a QID that is in this session's questionIds, but the challenge's linkedSessions does not include this sessionId
INDIRECT_CHALLENGE.source: challenge_registry.json → challenges[].questionId cross-referenced with session_registry.json → sessions[].questionIds

QID_OVERLAP.description: Two sessions share at least one QID in their questionIds arrays

RECOMMENDATION_QID.description: A recommendation's questionIds array overlaps with session questionIds
RECOMMENDATION_QID.source: recommendation_registry.json → recommendations[].questionIds cross-referenced with session questionIds

CERTIFICATION_QID.description: A certification wave's items array overlaps with session questionIds
CERTIFICATION_QID.source: certification_waves.json → waves[].items cross-referenced with session questionIds

qualityScore.description: Composite 0-100 health score for the session's questions
qualityScore.varietyScore: 100 for sessions touching multiple sections, 50 for single-section

riskLevel.description: Derived from qualityScore and flagged conditions

thresholds.CRITICAL: qualityScore < 30 OR has certified items with DL-008 exposure

defectDensity.description: Average number of defect references per unique QID in the session

challengeRate.description: Challenges per unique QID across both direct and indirect

revisionHistory.author: Board F — Session 252
revisionHistory.summary: Initial Session Intelligence Engine specification. Defines all output schemas, relationship types, enum definitions, and computation rules for session relationship analysis.
